findings.issue: Unmarked supplied copula. The clause is verbless: I + your she-donkey.
Preposition + adverb of continuance/still + 2ms suffix. siempre adds always and leaves out that continuance of the addressee.
Resumptive upon-me (1cs) is smoothed to sobre la cual. Same referent; the suffix person is not kept.

notes: Bilam is an unlocked proper name; the rest of the clause matches the tokens.
